tasks.title: Audit exposed pins and safe independent-hardware wiring options

notes.text: Recommended conditional mapping: INMP441 stays 14/47/48; SPEAKER2 moves to GPIO1/2/3. GPIO3 is a JTAG strapping pin, so add external 10 kΩ pull-up to 3V3 and validate reset/USB JTAG. GPIO45 is excluded because it straps VDD_SPI. Strict no-strap mapping is impossible with only 1,2,14,47,48 available. Docs do not themselves prove GPIO3/45 exposure or speaker power rail.
Hardware audit completed: independent mapping requires exposed GPIO3 and 5V regulated speaker rail; GPIO45 rejected.
